visualThread.motif: Intersecting circles and orthogonal bars arranged on an implied grid — Kandinsky's tension between curved and straight elements, recurring as a structural rhythm across all compositions
visualThread.atmosphere: Flat, high-contrast, no gradients. Hard-edged forms cast no shadows. Compositions feel architectural and deliberate, as if arranged on a drafting table under even studio light. White or black ground.
